result:
task: Measure W2-66's scoped close against the full close, compute its catch rate on lens H's planted faults, run the ladder's fixture trial, and write and commit `docs/research/W2-66-scoped-close.md`.

status: PACKAGES. The report is committed and all 165 cases pass. Two things go back to you: one package (W2-54's case runs `gov check` itself in every scoped close), and the fixture folder I could not remove.

work_completed: This worktree has no recorded green base, so the code would run the full regression here (`BASE_UNKNOWN`). I therefore computed the selection for the given changed path `src/gov/status/command.py`, as W1-32's close. I timed that selection with the close's own run functions (`_check_acceptance`, `_check_tests`, `_check_reds`) in the close's form, under `flock /tmp/gov-os-verify.lock`. I computed the selection for each of the 32 faults in `record/w2:…/lens-H/analysis_b2.json`. I ran three real `gov close` runs (this worktree's code) on a fixture built from nothing with W1-30's `Project`. Then I wrote, tested and committed the report.

files_changed: docs/research/W2-66-scoped-close.md

evidence:
- **Commit:** `4f676f479592d2f71480dbc095167189ba145e98`, trailers `Task: DAEO-c1uz`, `Role: engineer`, `Implements: DEC-880`, `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. After it, `git status --short` is empty and `git log --oneline -3` shows `4f676f47`, `c9686606`, `7c18f587`.
- **Code under test:** `gov.__file__` = `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-66/src/gov/__init__.py`.
- **Typical scoped close** (`scope: scoped`):
  - Selected: W1-32 (`OWN` + `OVERLAP` `DAEO-8goq`), `tests/unit`, W1-07's three every-close files, and the 26 record-reading targets.
  - Left out: 185 targets, each `NOT_REACHED` (43 whole suites and 142 files), plus 31 deselects.
  - Acceptance run: 9.2 s wall, 81 passed.
  - Regression parallel run: 676.6 s wall (pytest 616.97 s), 3,265 passed, 1 failed, 1 skipped.
  - Serial-only: 0 of the list's 54 entries were selected, so no serial run was made.
  - Reds judged in 1.4 s.
  - **Total 687 s (11.5 min) for 3,348 cases.** Load was `12.29 46.56 52.85` at the start and `65.47 71.07 61.56` at the end (the rise is the run's own workers).
  - Against the full close: 2,648.76 s for the lead's parallel run alone, 2,459 s for the retention trial, 72 min for DEC-883's close (31 + 29 min of tests). The scoped close runs 21 % of the cases in about 26 % of the parallel run's time.
- **Catch rate: 32 of 32.** The 24 faults outside the shared core: 24 of 24. Lens H's 22: 22 of 22. The 6 faults of the three widest modules and the 2 in `cli/main.py` run the full regression (`SHARED_CORE`), so every catching suite runs. That rests on lens H's rest run of 2026-10-22, not on any narrower mapping.
- **Fixture trial** (load 35 at the start, 30 at the end), all three closes exit 0:
  - Shared core: `scope: full`, `why_full: SHARED_CORE`, 3.7 s.
  - Record-only: `scoped`; ran its own suite, `tests/unit` and the record-reading test; left out FA, FB and FX1, each `NOT_REACHED`; 2.9 s.
  - One module: `scoped`; ran FA (`OVERLAP` `PROJ-alfa`), `tests/unit`, FX2 (close 2's work since the base) and the record-reading test; left out FB and FX1; 3.1 s.
  - Two earlier tries were refused by the gates because of faults in my fixture, not the code: an unresolvable `Implements:`, and a close record left uncommitted.
- **Scratch:**
  - Before the first runs: 37,329 inodes and 390 MB.
  - Before the timed run: 39,328 inodes and 412 MB.
  - During that run: 23,016 inodes and 201 MB.
  - At the end: 2,034 inodes and 27 MB for the whole of `/tmp/gov-os-lead-W2-66`, of which `eng-3` is 2,010 inodes and 27 MB.
  - Nothing untracked is left in the worktree.

tests: The brief's command (`tests/acceptance/W2-66`, W1-30's regression-scope file and W1-39's copy file, `-o tmp_path_retention_policy=failed`, no `-x`): **165 passed in 435.12 s**, load 39 at the start and 29 at the end.

discoveries:
- One case is 611 s of the scoped run's 617 s: W2-54's `test_gov_check_gives_context_reproducibility_green_here`, a record-reading case, runs `gov check` on the live tree. No file under `tests/acceptance/W2-54/` reads `GOV_CLOSE_CHECK_RESULT`. Without that case, the rest of the run is 1,411 s of summed case time with no case over 71 s, which I estimate (not measured) at about 1.5 to 3 min.
- That case was also red, because this worktree's store predates the ticket files (`DAEO-9nys`). This is environmental, not a miss of the selection.
- None of the serial-only list's 54 entries falls inside this typical selection.
- Lens H's evidence README describes `analysis_a6.json` and `analysis_b2.json` the wrong way round.
- All 32 planted faults have now run (the rest run of 2026-10-22).
- `gov close` leaves its record uncommitted for the orchestrator to commit.

risks:
- One timed sample, at a 1-minute load of 12, with 5- and 15-minute loads still about 50.
- The close's gates (pre-close collection, `gov check`, context) were not timed. The report's arithmetic for them (about 25 min of `gov close` and about 37 min with the queue's rebuild and check) is derived from DEC-883's figures, not measured.
- The catch rate rests on lens H's `F_suites`. Its controls found tests that react to a module's text in `config/loader.py` (5), `store/loader.py` (1), `cli/main.py` (1) and `doctor/command.py` (1).

lessons:
- Write shell targets as literal paths; the guard refuses variables in them.
- Inline `python3 -c` scripts with braces are refused as "cannot be read" (DEC-409): put the script in a file.
- Run the counterpart's tests directly with pytest; wrapped in `flock sh -c` they are refused as a read.
- A fixture's `Implements:` must name a record it holds (`DEC-000`).
- Commit each close's record before the next engineer commit.

proposed_decisions: **P-W2-66-a.** W2-54's test designer revises `test_gov_check_gives_context_reproducibility_green_here` (and its core-schema sibling) to read `GOV_CLOSE_CHECK_RESULT` when the close gives it, and to run `gov check` only when it doesn't. The close should also always pass `--check-result` from its pre-close gate. Recommended (b): revise the case. Confidence high that this removes about 10 of a typical scoped close's 11.5 min; medium on the exact remainder, since it is an estimate.

unresolved:
- `/tmp/gov-os-lead-W2-66/eng-3` (27 MB, 2,010 inodes) is still there. `rm -rf` needed a permission this session could not get, and I did not work around it. The lead or someone with the permission should remove it.
- Refusals, counted:
  - 1 guard read refusal (the wrapped pytest call, DEC-820 (c));
  - 2 other guard refusals (an unresolvable write target; "command cannot be read", DEC-409);
  - 2 harness permission prompts not granted (a `sed`/`rm` command; `rm -rf`).
  None was retried in the same form.
- `gov retrieve`: not used. I read the files the brief named directly, and the code graph was not needed.

recommended_next_action: The lead removes `/tmp/gov-os-lead-W2-66/eng-3`, runs its full verification on `4f676f47`, adds its figures, and takes P-W2-66-a to the orchestrator.
